title: SCARF Security in the Single-Key Model
summary: SCARF's claimed 80-bit security is not provided in the reported multi-key setting, while the security that can be established in the single-key model remains unresolved.

formal_statement.body: For SCARF, an unresolved question is what security can be established in the single-key model, given that full 8-round distinguishing attacks in the multi-key setting show that SCARF does not provide its claimed 80-bit security in that setting. Addressing the single-key question may require redefining the notion of bit security.

scope.domain: This concerns symmetric cryptanalysis of SCARF security under single-key and multi-key models.
parameters: Single-key versus multi-key model, the security setting
Full 8-round instance, the reported attack scope
Claimed 80-bit security, the stated security target
Bit-security notion, which may require redefinition
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine what security can be established for SCARF in the single-key model, potentially after redefining the notion of bit security.

progress.summary: The source explicitly calls the single-key question an interesting open question after reporting full 8-round distinguishing attacks in the multi-key setting. It says that answering it may require redefining bit security.
citation_labels: Christina Boura et al., Multiple-Tweak Differential Attack Against SCARF
